content.short_description: Hilti M12x60-A4-80 hex bolt, M12x1.75 thread, 60 mm length, 316 stainless steel, A4-80 property class, 800 MPa tensile strength, per ISO 3506.
content.long_description:
The Hilti M12x60-A4-80 is a hex-drive hex bolt manufactured from 316 stainless steel, sized M12 with a 1.75 mm thread pitch and 60 mm overall length. It is produced to the A4-80 property class, corresponding to a minimum tensile strength of 800 MPa, and manufactured in accordance with ISO 3506, the standard governing mechanical properties of corrosion-resistant stainless steel fasteners.

The hex head/drive design allows tightening with standard hex tooling. The M12x1.75 thread size and pitch are compatible with standard M12 nuts, tapped holes, and mating hardware conforming to the same thread specification.

316 stainless steel construction is used in fasteners specified for corrosion-resistant applications. The A4-80 designation indicates the alloy grade (A4, molybdenum-bearing austenitic stainless) combined with the strength class (80, denoting 800 MPa minimum tensile strength).

Use this bolt where M12x1.75 thread engagement, 60 mm grip/length, and ISO 3506 compliance are specified requirements. Confirm mating nut, washer, and application torque values against the A4-80 property class before installation.
